appendix.title: List of Supported Journal Styles
appendix.p: This appendix contains the list of supported journals and their short name codes. To specify one of these journals, use the publication file. See .
The code for a journal is taken from the list of abbreviations used by MathSciNet available at https://mathscinet.ams.org/msnhtml/serials.pdf.

The third column gives the Citation Style Language (CSL) style that naming the journal selects for the bibliography and citations. Journals listed with (none) have no style available, and their references are formatted by in its usual way. See to choose a style yourself instead.
